arxiv-2106-06490.title: Self-Organized Criticality in Stellar Flares
arxiv-2106-06490.creator: Markus J. Aschwanden, Manuel Güdel
arxiv-2106-06490.description: Abstract Power law size distributions are the hallmarks of nonlinear energy dissipation processes governed by self-organized criticality. Here we analyze 75 data sets of stellar flare size distributions, mostly obtained from the Extreme Ultra-Violet Explorer (EUVE) and the Kepler mission.

arxiv-2112-06930.title: The ups and downs of inelastic dark matter: Electron recoils from terrestrial upscattering Preprint: TTK-21-53
arxiv-2112-06930.creator: Timon Emken, Jonas Frerick, Saniya Heeba, Felix Kahlhoefer
arxiv-2112-06930.description: Abstract The growing interest in the interactions between dark matter particles and electrons has received a further boost by the observation of an excess in electron recoil events in the XENON1T experiment. Of particular interest are dark matter models in which the scattering process is inelastic, such that the ground state can upscatter into an excited state.

arxiv-2202-03069.title: Weak dissipation drives and enhances Wada basins in three-dimensional chaotic scattering Note: This work has been supported by the Spanish State Research Agency (AEI) and the European Regional Development Fund (ERDF, EU) under Project No. PID2019-105554GB-I00.
arxiv-2202-03069.creator: Diego S. Fernández, Jesús M. Seoane, Miguel A.F. Sanjuán
arxiv-2202-03069.description: Abstract Chaotic scattering in three dimensions has not received as much attention as in two dimensions so far. In this paper, we deal with a three-dimensional open Hamiltonian system whose Wada basin boundaries become non Wada when the critical energy value is surpassed in the absence of dissipation.

arxiv-2203-16549.title: Exponential Approach to the Hydrodynamic Attractor in Yang-Mills Kinetic Theory
arxiv-2203-16549.creator: Xiaojian Du, Michal P. Heller, Sören Schlichting, Viktor Svensson
arxiv-2203-16549.description: Abstract We use principal component analysis to study the hydrodynamic attractor in Yang-Mills kinetic theory undergoing the Bjorken expansion with Color Glass Condensate initial conditions. The late time hydrodynamic attractor is characterized by a single principal component determining the overall energy scale.

arxiv-2204-07834.title: Bridging Cross-Lingual Gaps During Leveraging the Multilingual Sequence-to-Sequence Pretraining for Text Generation and Understanding
arxiv-2204-07834.creator: Changtong Zan, Liang Ding, Li Shen, Yu Cao, Weifeng Liu, and Dacheng Tao
arxiv-2204-07834.description: Abstract For multilingual sequence-to-sequence pretrained language models (multilingual Seq2Seq PLMs), e.g. mBART [ 1 ] , the self-supervised pretraining task is trained on a wide range of monolingual languages, e.g. 25 languages from CommonCrawl 1 1 1 https://commoncrawl.org/the-data/ , while the downstream cross-lingual tasks generally progress on a bilingual language subset, e.g.

arxiv-2208-13523.title: Demystifying the COVID-19 vaccine discourse on Twitter
arxiv-2208-13523.creator: Zainab Zaidi, Mengbin Ye, Fergus John Samon, Abdisalam Jama, Binduja Gopalakrishnan, Chenhao Gu, Shanika Karunasekera, Jamie Evans, Yoshihisa Kashima
arxiv-2208-13523.description: Abstract Developing an understanding of the public discourse on COVID-19 vaccination on social media is important not only for addressing the current COVID-19 pandemic, but also for future pathogen outbreaks. We examine a Twitter dataset containing 75 million English tweets discussing COVID-19 vaccination from March 2020 to March 2021.

arxiv-2310-07982.title: Multistability for Nematic Liquid Crystals in Cuboids with Degenerate Planar Boundary Conditions Thanks: This work was partially supported by National Natural Science Foundation of China (Grant No. 12225102, T2321001, 12050002, 12288101), Newton Advanced Fellowship, Leverhulme Research Project Grant
arxiv-2310-07982.creator: Baoming Shi, Yucen Han, Apala Majumdar, Lei Zhang
arxiv-2310-07982.description: Abstract We study nematic configurations within three-dimensional (3D) cuboids, with planar degenerate boundary conditions on the cuboid faces, in the Landau-de Gennes framework. There are two geometry-dependent variables: the edge length of the square cross-section, λ \lambda , and the parameter h h , which is a measure of the cuboid height.

arxiv-2407-15616.title: Sustainable broadcasting in Blockchain Networks with Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2407-15616.creator: Danila Valko, Daniel Kudenko
arxiv-2407-15616.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Danila Valko, Daniel Kudenko. Recent estimates put the carbon footprint of Bitcoin and Ethereum at an average of 64 and 26 million tonnes of C ​ O 2 CO_{2} per year, respectively. To address this growing problem, several possible approaches have been proposed in the literature: creating alternative blockchain consensus mechanisms, applying redundancy reduction techniques, utilizing renewable energy sources, and employing energy-efficient devices, etc.

arxiv-2509-13824.title: Contrasting magnetic anisotropy in CrCl 3 and CrBr 3 : A first-principles study
arxiv-2509-13824.creator: Jiazhuang Si 1 , Shuyuan Liu 2 , Bing Wang 1∗ , Chongze Wang 2 , Fengzhu Ren 1 , Yu Jia 3,4 , and Jun-Hyung Cho 1,2∗
arxiv-2509-13824.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jiazhuang Si 1 , Shuyuan Liu 2 , Bing Wang 1∗ , Chongze Wang 2 , Fengzhu Ren 1 , Yu Jia 3,4 , and Jun-Hyung Cho 1,2∗. We present a first-principles study of the contrasting easy magnetization axes (EMAs) in the layered chromium trihalides CrCl 3 and CrBr 3 , which exhibit in-plane and out-of-plane EMAs, respectively.

arxiv-2510-19666.title: A Graph Engine for Guitar Chord-Tone Soloing Education
arxiv-2510-19666.description: Abstract We present a graph-based engine for computing chord tone soloing suggestions for guitar students. Chord tone soloing is a fundamental practice for improvising over a chord progression, where the instrumentalist uses only the notes contained in the current chord. This practice is a building block for all advanced jazz guitar theory but is difficult to learn and practice.

pmc-10544197.title: Argininosuccinate lyase deficiency causes blood-brain barrier disruption via nitric oxide–mediated dysregulation of claudin expression
pmc-10544197.creator: Jordan Kho, Urszula Polak, Ming-Ming Jiang, John D. Odom, Jill V. Hunter, Saima M. Ali, Lindsay C. Burrage, Sandesh C.S. Nagamani, Robia G. Pautler, Hannah P. Thompson, Akihiko Urayama, Zixue Jin, Brendan Lee
pmc-10544197.description: Nitric oxide (NO) is a critical signaling molecule that has been implicated in the pathogenesis of neurocognitive diseases. Both excessive and insufficient NO production have been linked to pathology. Previously, we have shown that argininosuccinate lyase deficiency (ASLD) is a novel model system to investigate cell-autonomous, nitric oxide synthase–dependent NO deficiency.

pmc-11488061.title: Adherence to sulfadoxine-pyrimethamine five-dose policy among pregnant women in an urban slum in Ghana: a mixed-methods study
pmc-11488061.creator: Hainau Iddrisu, Emmanuel Ayitey Tagoe, Harriet Affran Bonful
pmc-11488061.description: BackgroundMalaria in pregnancy (MiP) is a public health concern especially for pregnant women living in slums. The World Health Organization recommends at least three doses of Sulfadoxine-Pyrimethamine (SP) to prevent MiP. In Ghana, it is recommended that pregnant women receive a minimum of five doses of the medication.

pmc-12549776.title: A Re-Exploration of our Unconscious: What We Have Come To Unmask; What Still Lies Beneath
pmc-12549776.creator: Myron Tsikandilakis, Persefoni Bali, Victοria-Maria Pasachidou, Romina Leonor Toranzos, Konrad Szczesniak, Pierre-Alexis Mével, Christopher Madan, Alison Milbank
pmc-12549776.description: In this manuscript, concepts, issues and resolutions that call for conscious awareness in research into the unconscious are revisited and reviewed. Historical episodes and episodes of controversial experimentation that are formative rallying points for understanding contemporary attitudes to the unconscious in psychological science, and the impact of historical controversy to contemporary polarisation, are meticulously discussed.

pmc-12551351.title: Dual-task walking for early detection of Alzheimer’s disease: comparative analysis of tasks using whole-body gait variables
pmc-12551351.creator: Ryoto Katagiri, Yasunori Yamada, Kaoru Shinkawa, Masatomo Kobayashi, Miyuki Nemoto, Miho Ota, Kiyotaka Nemoto, Tetsuaki Arai, Ken Takiyama
pmc-12551351.description: BackgroundThe worldwide rise in dementia creates an urgent need for screening methods that are both sensitive and easy to administer. Dual-task walking—requiring people to walk while performing a second cognitive or motor task—meets these criteria because it stresses gait and cognition simultaneously, revealing deficits that emerge early in Alzheimer’s disease and Mild Cognitive Impairment (MCI).

pmc-12564377.title: The Impact of Centrifugation Devices and Collection Tubes on Fibrin Characteristics and Growth Factor Release Under High- and Low-Speed Protocols
pmc-12564377.creator: Oranit Bunyatratchata, Wutigri Nimlamool, Supatra Sangin, Darinca Carmen Todea
pmc-12564377.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background: Platelet-rich fibrin (PRF) is an autologous platelet concentrate (APC) produced through blood centrifugation. Despite the development of various centrifugation systems, protocol variability continues to pose challenges in selecting the optimal method. This study investigated the effects of three different centrifuges and collection tubes on the fibrin characteristics and growth factor release in leukocyte- and platelet-rich fibrin (L-PRF) and advanced platelet-rich fibrin plus (A-PRF+).

pmc-12926744.title: Initial assessment of all-season Arctic sea ice thickness from ICESat-2
pmc-12926744.creator: Alek Petty, Alex Cabaj, Jack C. Landy
pmc-12926744.description: We present an initial assessment of all-season Arctic sea ice thickness estimates from ICESat-2 by combining freeboard retrievals with all-season SnowModel-LG snow loading. ICESat-2 captures the key regional and seasonal patterns of Arctic sea ice variability and shows good agreement with CryoSat-2 all-season estimates, including regional patterns of inter-annual variability in summer ice thickness.

pmc-13312461.title: Clot value: Why mechanical thrombectomy may be the smartest investment in iliofemoral deep vein thrombosis care
pmc-13312461.creator: Nicolas J Mouawad
pmc-13312461.description: ause they address one of the most important unresolved questions in contemporary venous disease management: how does one optimize outcomes for patients with iliofemoral deep vein thrombosis (IFDVT) while maintaining responsible health care spending in an increasingly financially constrained environment?

pmc-13339729.title: Exploring perception of coarticulatory cues in childhood apraxia of speech and residual speech sound disorders: A pilot study
pmc-13339729.creator: Molly Beiting, Navin Viswanathan, Nicole Caballero, Elaine Hitchcock, Tara McAllister, Jonathan L Preston
pmc-13339729.description: Introduction:Children with childhood apraxia of speech (CAS) exhibit speech production deficits beyond segmental errors, including atypical coarticulation. Broadly, children with speech sound disorders (SSD) also exhibit weaknesses in speech perception, which may directly relate to specific production difficulties. This study examined differences in categorical perception among children with CAS, residual SSD affecting /ɹ/ (rSSD), and typical speech (TD).

pmc-13354643.title: Oxygen-generating Microparticles Enhance Viability and Functionality of Human Pluripotent Stem Cell-derived Cardiomyocytes for Myocardial Infarction Therapy
pmc-13354643.creator: Xingyu He, Suchandrima Dutta, Darshini Desai, Sheng Zhong, William Liu, Sophie Chen, Wei Huang, Waqas Ahmad, Jialiang Liang, Yigang Wang
pmc-13354643.description: BackgroundHuman induced pluripotent stem cell-derived cardiomyocytes (hiPSC-CMs) represent a promising therapy for myocardial infarction (MI), but their survival is severely limited by the hypoxic infarct environment. The optimal oxygen levels required to maintain the viability and functionality of hiPSC-CMs remain poorly defined. This study aimed to develop a controlled oxygen-delivery system to support engineered heart tissue (EHT) for cardiac regeneration.

pmc-13404311.title: Longitudinal plasma p-tau217 as a marker for tracking progression and predicting cognitive decline in Alzheimer’s disease
pmc-13404311.creator: Jehyun Ahn, Jihwan Yun, Michael W. Weiner, Daeun Shin, Heekyoung Kang, Sohyun Yim, Seonghyeon Kim, Heekyoung Park, Hyemin Jang, Min Young Chun, Eun Hye Lee, Hee Jin Kim, Duk L. Na, Jun Pyo Kim, Sang Won Seo, the ADNI study group
pmc-13404311.description: BackgroundPlasma phosphorylated tau217 (p-tau217) is a promising biomarker for Alzheimer’s disease (AD) with strong cross-sectional concordance with beta-amyloid (Aβ) and tau pathology. However, its longitudinal behavior across disease stages and assay platforms, and its prognostic value for cognitive decline according to Aβ status, remain insufficiently characterized.

pmc-13471179.title: Internists’ deprescribing behavior for proton pump inhibitor therapy: a qualitative study based on the theoretical domains framework internists’ deprescribing behavior for PPI therapy
pmc-13471179.creator: Beyza Nur Ataoğlu, Betul Okuyan, Rabia Yaren Şahin, Beril Koçak, Ayberk Denizli, Asiye Sena Anli, Pınar Ay
pmc-13471179.description: BackgroundProton pump inhibitors (PPIs) are among the most frequently prescribed medications. However, they are often used inappropriately and may cause adverse effects in long-term use. This study aimed to explore internists’ beliefs, attitudes and behaviors regarding deprescribing PPIs in Türkiye, by using the Theoretical Domains Framework (TDF).MethodsThis qualitative study was conducted at a university hospital in Türkiye.

pmc-13517271.title: Numeric Analysis of Polarized Lidar Contrast Enhancement Across Diverse Targets in Fog
pmc-13517271.creator: Manuel Petzi, Dominik Reitzle, Alwin Kienle
pmc-13517271.description: Lidar systems are of major importance for driver assistance systems and autonomous driving, but their obstacle detection range can be heavily impaired by adverse weather conditions like fog. To mitigate the effects of fog, the use of polarized light has been proposed.

pmc-13540947.title: Factor selection in configurational comparative analysis – guidance for implementation researchers
pmc-13540947.creator: Laura Caci, Kathrin Blum, Lauren Clack, Bianca Albers

pmc-13572007.title: Do glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists influence cervical fusion outcomes? A systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13572007.creator: Matheus Loiola Magalhães Alves, Antônio Olímpio da Silva Moura Costa, Julia do Vale Moura Costa, Gustavo Azevedo Garrido, João Victor Pereira Gonzalez, Julia Sader Neves Ferreira, Bernardo de Andrada Pereira
pmc-13572007.description: BackgroundGlucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) are increasingly used in patients with obesity and type 2 diabetes, but their procedure-specific effects in cervical fusion remain unclear.MethodsA systematic review and meta-analysis following PRISMA 2020 and MOOSE, prospectively registered in PROSPERO, searched PubMed, Embase, and Web of Science through April 28, 2026.

pmc-13583836.title: Participant views of case finding for COPD after lung cancer screening: the C FIND COPD study
pmc-13583836.creator: Olivia R Phillips, Tricia M McKeever, Joanne Porte, Paula C A Almeida, Emma L O’Dowd, Rachael L Murray, Charlotte E Bolton
pmc-13583836.description: BackgroundEarly and accurate diagnosis of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is essential to ensure correct management and minimise future morbidity. Therefore, case finding in symptomatic at-risk individuals is highly valuable. The C FIND COPD study invited symptomatic people at risk of COPD for a COPD case-finding diagnostic assessment. These individuals had undergone a previous lung cancer screening low-dose CT.

pmc-13611364.title: Enhanced Multifunctional Properties of Bipyridyl-Containing Polyurethane Nanocomposites Reinforced with Graphene/ZnO Hybrid Fillers
pmc-13611364.creator: Jing-Lun Chen, Yun-Shao Huang, Wen-Chin Tsen, Chi-Hui Tsou, Chin-Wen Chen, Maw-Cherng Suen
pmc-13611364.description: A series of polyurethane (PU) nanocomposites incorporating 4,4′-bis(hydroxymethyl)-2,2′-bipyridine (BBD) as a chain extender and a commercially supplied graphene/zinc oxide (G/ZnO) hybrid filler were successfully synthesized. The effects of G/ZnO loading (0–2.0 wt.%) on the structural, thermal, mechanical, surface-wettability, and antibacterial properties of the nanocomposites were systematically investigated.

pmc-13626249.title: Anterior tumour location as a risk factor for local recurrence after laparoscopic surgery for stage I ultra-low rectal cancers: exploratory analysis of the Ultimate trial
pmc-13626249.creator: Atsushi Kohyama, Shinobu Ohnuma, Yuichiro Tsukada, Michiaki Unno, Jun Watanabe, Yosuke Fukunaga, Yasumitsu Hirano, Kazuhiro Sakamoto, Hiroki Hamamoto, Masanori Yoshimitsu, Hisanaga Horie, Nobuhisa Matsuhashi, Yoshiaki Kuriu, Shuntaro Nagai, Madoka Hamada, Shinichi Yoshioka, Tamuro Hayama, Koki Otsuk
pmc-13626249.description: BackgroundAnterior tumour location is an established risk factor for local recurrence (LR) in advanced rectal cancer, but its significance in stage I ultra-low rectal cancer remains unclear.MethodsThis exploratory supplemental analysis used data from Ultimate trial, a multicentre prospective phase II study across 47 Japanese institutions (2014–2017).
